title: Free YouTube downloader (Sonika Video Downloader)
summary: Downloader websites are full of ads, popups and fake buttons, and often no 4K. So I built a free app with Codex: fixed the bugs in 2 to 3 prompts and redesigned the UI from a reference I made in ChatGPT. Paste a YouTube, Instagram or Pinterest link, pick the quality, done.
steps: Download Sonika Video Downloader from this page (Windows 10/11).
Open the app. No login, no ads.
Copy the link of a YouTube, Instagram or Pinterest video.
Paste it into the app and pick the quality.
Click download. Only download videos you own or have permission to use.

prompts.title: Break down a reference video
prompts.text:
I downloaded a reference video for my edit: [VIDEO FILE PATH OR DESCRIBE IT / ATTACH SCREENSHOTS].

Break it down so I can learn from it:
1. A shot list with rough timestamps: shot type, what's on screen, text on screen.
2. The pacing: average cut length, where it speeds up or slows down.
3. Graphics and transitions used, and how I could rebuild each one in [PREMIERE PRO / YOUR EDITOR].
4. What makes the hook work in the first 3 seconds.

Keep it short and practical. Don't copy the creator's content; give me ideas I can adapt to my own footage.

prompts.title: Redesign my app's UI from a reference image
prompts.text:
I have a small app I built: [APP FOLDER PATH]. I made a UI reference image: [ATTACH IMAGE].

Redesign the app's interface to match the reference: layout, colors, spacing, fonts and buttons. Rules:
- Keep every feature working exactly as it does now.
- Change only UI code. Show me the plan and the list of files you will change before editing.
- Make a backup or work on a new git branch first.
- After the change, run the app and tell me how to test each button.

notes: Only download videos you own or have permission to use.
Works with YouTube, Instagram and Pinterest links. Windows 10/11.
